lessons_learned: accuracy: Incorrect technical claim detected: rag updates the model weights. RAG retrieves external information without directly retraining the model.
Remove the contradictory and factually incorrect line: 'Testing statement: RAG updates the model weights.'
Explicitly reinforce in the summary that RAG is an inference-time (runtime) technique and does not involve model fine-tuning or parameter updates.
Add a brief clarification on what happens if the vector database does not find relevant documents (fallback/safe response behavior).
